distribution.narrative: Lin & Beaver (2021) provides the first Taiwan record of Hypothenemus aulmanni, based on two females collected in a funnel trap at Sun Moon Lake, Nantou.

host_note: The Taiwan specimens were trap-caught and have no direct host association. The paper lists Bauhinia variegata, Sesbania grandiflora, Gossypium sp. and Artocarpus heterophyllus from earlier literature; these are retained in the historical/source-evidence layer rather than promoted as Taiwan current hosts.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hypothenemus aulmanni (Hagedorn, 1912).
